name: Australian Netlink
summary: Melbourne ISP (PeeVee Software Solutions Pty Ltd T/A Australian Netlink, South Melbourne, AS7601); founded ~1994 by Peter Vaskess; at peak >7000 dialup customers and >500 hosted domains; a Victoria Internet Exchange (VIX) member; business closed 2005 and customer base sold (buyer not identified in public records), so no successor transition is possible (ACN 007 266 364).

events.details: Early Melbourne ISP (AS7601); Australia-wide dialup. Founding c. 1994 predates the archive; earliest Wayback capture is 22 Dec 1996 (netlink.com.au).
Business closed and customer base sold (per Managing Director Peter Vaskess); buyer not identified.
